description: This file defines the ValidationResult class in the Drupal package_manager module, representing validation outcomes with severity, messages, and summary, including methods for creating error/warning results and evaluating overall severity.

classes.name: ValidationResult
classes.description: A value object encapsulating validation results, including severity, messages, and summary, with methods for creating error/warning results and assessing overall severity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor initializing severity, messages, and optional summary, with validation for translatability and message presence.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access private messages property.

methods.name: createErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Creates a ValidationResult error object from a Throwable, determining translatability.

methods.name: createError
methods.description: Creates an error ValidationResult with specified messages and optional summary.

methods.name: createWarning
methods.description: Creates a warning ValidationResult with specified messages and optional summary.

methods.name: getOverallSeverity
methods.description: Determines the overall severity from an array of ValidationResult objects, prioritizing errors.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Checks if two ValidationResult objects are equivalent based on severity, summary, and messages.
